visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four men are lined up on a sunny sandy beach under a clear blue sky. They perform a synchronized walking-in-place motion with rhythmic arm swings. One man wears bright red swim trunks and sunglasses; the next wears a black t-shirt and a baseball cap; the third is a larger man in a black tank top and shorts; the fourth is a slim man in black swim trunks. The background features a calm turquoise ocean with numerous people swimming and distant boats on the horizon. (2) The scene cuts to a massive grey battleship docked at a pier. The four men continue their synchronized walking motion on the concrete ground in front of the ship's large guns and superstructure. They have changed some clothing; for example, the first man now wears tan shorts and a black polo shirt. The lighting is bright and direct, casting clear shadows on the ground. A sign with the word ENTRANCE is partially visible on the ship's side. (3) The group is now on a lush green lawn bordering a rocky coastline. They maintain their rhythmic movement in the same order. Behind them, a large green tree provides some shade, and the dark volcanic rocks meet the blue ocean under a bright, cloudless sky. The environment appears to be a tropical park or coastal reserve with the men dressed in casual t-shirts and shorts. (4) The setting shifts to a dark, barren volcanic field during sunset. The sun is partially obscured by clouds, creating a dramatic, warm glow and a hazy atmosphere. The four men are dressed in casual t-shirts and shorts as they continue their walking-in-place routine across the uneven, dark ground. The lighting is low and warm, highlighting the silhouettes of the hills in the distance. (5) They are back on a tropical beach shoreline. To their right, palm trees lean over the sand, and a traditional thatched-roof hut is visible in the background. The men walk rhythmically along the edge of the water. The sky is bright blue with scattered white clouds, and the lighting is soft and natural. (6) The final shot shows the four men as silhouettes against a brilliant setting sun over the ocean. They continue their synchronized walking motion along the beach. The sunlight reflects off the water's surface, creating a shimmering path. The color tone is warm and golden, with high contrast between the dark figures and the bright background.
